pseudo_gt_note: NO human GT. Person-only pseudo GT = WBF(IoU 0.55) of ensemble ['yolox_x', 'yolox_l', 'yolov8m', 'yolo11m', 'yolov7', 'rtdetr_r50'] person dets (score>=0.3), kept if supported by >=3 distinct models; ensemble members are scored leave-one-out. AP = all-point interpolation over preds with score>=0.25; pseudoAP = mean over IoU 0.5:0.05:0.95.
